title: Mood Manipulation and PST, Experiment 2
description: EEG dataset from a reinforcement learning study of 50 healthy controls, 25 tested after a sad mood manipulation and 25 after a happy mood manipulation. Participants completed a probabilistic selection task with training and testing phases. The task was adapted from a Parkinsonism reinforcement learning paradigm, and the mood manipulation was delivered before each training block.
methods_description: Participants performed a Matlab-based reinforcement learning task (probabilistic selection task) with a training section and a testing section. A sad or happy mood manipulation was administered during the task before each training block. Data were collected from 2019 to 2021 at the Cognitive Rhythms and Computation Lab, University of New Mexico.
